entry.title: An LLM Is Not a Deficient Mind
entry.summary: I called it "the perfect bullshitter." This was GPT-2, maybe early GPT-3. I was feeding it prompts and getting back text that looked like answers — structured, fluent, confident. The kind of output that would survive a casual reading. It was not grounded in anything. The model was hallucinating probable responses, assembling tokens that matched what you'd expect to see in text that answered that kind of question. Whether it matched reality was beside the point. I work with multi-agent systems now — code reviewers, planners, critics. The systems are better. The outputs are sharper. But the property I noticed back then has not gone away.
